paite: TOUPA, na gam tung ah na kipak a; sal a om Jakob na pikik nawnta hi.
heading: Korah tapate phatna La / Nam Hoihna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

paite: Na mite thulimlouhnate na ngaidam a, agitlouhna tengteng uh na khuh khinta hi. Selah
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

paite: Na thangpaihna tengteng na lamang a; na hehna thupitak na kiheisanta hi.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

paite: Hon hondampa Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla, ka tung ua na hehna tawpsak in.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

paite: Ka tung uah na heh nilouh dia hia? Na hehna suan tengteng tan in na kitheisak zel dia hia?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

paite: Nangmah a na mite akipahtheihna ding un na hon hihhalh nawn kei dia hia?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna hon musak inla, na hotdamna leng hon pia in.
english: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

paite: TOUPA Pathian thu gen ding ka ngaikhe ding; amite leh amisiangthoute kiang ah khamuanna thu agen dek a, himahleh amau haina lam ah kihei nawnta kei uhen.
english: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

paite: Ahotdamna amah kihtate naih in a-om ngeingei nak hi; i gam ua thupina a-omtheihna ding in.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak akituak a; diktatna leh kituahna akitawptuah a,
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

paite: Thutak lei a kipan in adawnkhia a; diktatna in van a pan ahon tansukta hi.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

paite: Ahi, TOUPA'N thil hoih ape ding a; i gam in leng athilpou ape ding hi.
english: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

paite: Diktatna in ama akai ding a; akhapte lampi ah asiam ding hi.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
